12.psychological_impact: Isolation needs. Spiritual seeking. Foreign connections. Subconscious mind active. Sleep issues. Expenses on mother.
12.recommendation: Your mind needs solitude for rejuvenation. Spiritual practices and meditation are essential for mental health.
